subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration actions in `SKILL.md` metadata, and what URL/action trust contract should the dashboard use?
rationale: The implementation shape is understandable, but accepting skill-provided configuration URLs changes public skill metadata and dashboard trust semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a generic, typed skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Keep existing link surfaces
options.body: Do not add new frontmatter fields now; document `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration discovery path.

options.title: Prototype through ClawHub first
options.body: Let ClawHub or Skill Card metadata carry configuration links first, then add a core dashboard action only after the trust model settles.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a generic, typed skill configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Skills page, skill metadata surface, and dashboard URL handling that recent history routes through this contributor's area.
